  const [fitPartial, setFitPartial] = useState(false)
  const zoomTweenTimerRef = useRef<number | null>(null)
  const markZoomTween = useCallback((): void => {
    if (reducedMotion || typeof window === 'undefined') {
      return
    }
    setZoomTweening(true)
    if (zoomTweenTimerRef.current !== null) {
      window.clearTimeout(zoomTweenTimerRef.current)
    }
    zoomTweenTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      zoomTweenTimerRef.current = null
      setZoomTweening(false)
    }, ZOOM_TWEEN_MS)
  }, [reducedMotion])
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (zoomTweenTimerRef.current !== null) {
        window.clearTimeout(zoomTweenTimerRef.current)
        zoomTweenTimerRef.current = null
      }
    }

  const [panning, setPanning] = useState(false)
  const [tileOffset, setTileOffset] = useState<Record<string, Point>>({})
  const [tileSizeOverride, setTileSizeOverride] = useState<

export function isImageEmoji(value?: string): boolean {
  if (!value) {
    return false
  }
  const trimmed = value.trim()
  return (
    trimmed.startsWith('data:image/') ||
    trimmed.startsWith('http://') ||
    trimmed.startsWith('https://') ||
    trimmed.startsWith('file://') ||
    trimmed.startsWith('/')
  )
}

export function resolveSpaceBgStyle(bgColor?: string): {
  backgroundColor?: string
  isLight: boolean
} {
  if (!bgColor || !bgColor.trim() || bgColor === 'default') {
    return { isLight: false }
  }
  const preset = SPACE_BG_PRESETS.find((p) => p.id === bgColor || p.bg === bgColor)
  if (preset) {
    return {
      ...(preset.bg ? { backgroundColor: preset.bg } : {}),
      isLight: preset.isLight
    }
  }
  const trimmed = bgColor.trim()
  if (/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(trimmed)) {
    const r = Number.parseInt(trimmed.slice(1, 3), 16)
    const g = Number.parseInt(trimmed.slice(3, 5), 16)
    const b = Number.parseInt(trimmed.slice(5, 7), 16)
    const luminance = (0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b) / 255
    return {
      backgroundColor: `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, 0.93)`,
      isLight: luminance > 0.58
    }
  }
  return { backgroundColor: trimmed, isLight: false }
}

export function defaultSpaceEmoji(
  title: string,
  level: SpaceLevel = 'general',
  explicitEmoji?: string
): string {
  if (explicitEmoji && explicitEmoji.trim()) {
    return explicitEmoji.trim()
  }
  const lower = (title || '').toLowerCase()
  if (/supplier|peptide|lab|manufactur|chem|source/.test(lower)) {
    return '🧪'
  }
  if (/fulfill|3pl|ship|logistic|warehouse|deliv/.test(lower)) {
    return '📦'
  }
  if (/ad|meta|facebook|creative|hook|campaign|marketing/.test(lower)) {
    return '📣'
  }
  if (/video|ugc|reel|tiktok|wan|storyboard/.test(lower)) {
    return '🎬'
  }
  if (/sale|deal|whatsapp|imessage|close|revenue|money|checkout/.test(lower)) {
    return '💰'
  }
  if (/profile|warm|phone|vmos|cloak|account/.test(lower)) {
    return '🛡️'
  }
  if (/code|build|orca|app|bug|agent|bot/.test(lower)) {
    return '🤖'
  }
  if (/shop|store|funnel|trust|offer|ecom/.test(lower)) {
    return '🛒'
  }
  switch (level) {
    case 'P1':
      return '🔥'
    case 'P2':
      return '🚀'
    case 'P3':
      return '⚡'
    case 'side':
      return '✨'
    default:
      return '🎯'
  }
}

export function buildAgentSnapshotSig({
  liveBusy,
  liveAttention,
  msgSig
}: {
  liveBusy?: boolean
  liveAttention?: boolean
  msgSig?: string | null
}): string {
  const busyBit = liveBusy ? '1' : '0'
  const attnBit = !liveBusy && liveAttention ? '1' : '0'
  return `${busyBit}|${attnBit}|${(msgSig ?? '').trim()}`
}

export function resolveEffectiveAgentState({
  tabId,
  liveBusy,
  liveAttention,
  msgSig,
  snapshotSig,
  overrides
}: {
  tabId: string
  liveBusy: boolean
  liveAttention: boolean
  msgSig?: string
  snapshotSig?: string
  overrides?: Readonly<AgentStateOverrideMap> | null
}): {
  busy: boolean
  attention: boolean
  manualMode: ManualAgentStateMode
} {
  const autoBusy = Boolean(liveBusy)
  const autoAttention = !autoBusy && Boolean(liveAttention)
  const override = tabId && overrides ? overrides[tabId] : undefined
  if (!override || !override.snapshotSig) {
    return { busy: autoBusy, attention: autoAttention, manualMode: 'auto' }
  }
  const currentSig =
    snapshotSig ??
    buildAgentSnapshotSig({
      liveBusy: autoBusy,
      liveAttention: autoAttention,
      msgSig
    })
  if (override.snapshotSig !== currentSig) {
    return { busy: autoBusy, attention: autoAttention, manualMode: 'auto' }
  }
  if (override.mode === 'working') {
    return { busy: true, attention: false, manualMode: 'working' }
  }
  if (override.mode === 'attention') {
    return { busy: false, attention: true, manualMode: 'attention' }
  }
  return { busy: false, attention: false, manualMode: 'idle' }
}

const OLD_PRIORITIES: Record<string, SpaceLevel> = { P0: 'P1', P1: 'P2', P2: 'P3' }

type LegacyGoal = Omit<Partial<SpaceGoal>, 'outcomes' | 'roadmap'> & {
  outcomes?: unknown
  roadmap?: unknown
  kind?: unknown
  priority?: unknown
  outcome?: unknown
  kpis?: { label?: unknown; current?: unknown; target?: unknown }[]
}

function isValidLayout(value: unknown): value is SpaceLayout {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') {
    return false
  }
  const c = value as Record<string, unknown>
  return [c.x, c.y, c.w, c.h].every((v) => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v))
}

function clampLayout(raw: SpaceLayout): SpaceLayout {
  return {
    x: Math.max(-100_000, Math.min(100_000, raw.x)),
    y: Math.max(-100_000, Math.min(100_000, raw.y)),
    w: Math.max(80, Math.min(4000, raw.w)),
    h: Math.max(60, Math.min(8000, raw.h))
  }
}

function levelOf(raw: LegacyGoal): SpaceLevel {
  if (SPACE_LEVELS.includes(raw.level as SpaceLevel)) {
    return raw.level as SpaceLevel
  }
  if (raw.kind === 'side') {
    return 'side'
  }
  if (typeof raw.priority === 'string' && Object.hasOwn(OLD_PRIORITIES, raw.priority)) {
    return OLD_PRIORITIES[raw.priority] ?? 'general'
  }
  return 'general'
}

export function normalizeGoal(raw: LegacyGoal): SpaceGoal {
  const kpis = Array.isArray(raw.kpis) ? raw.kpis : []
  const rawOutcomes: SpaceOutcome[] = Array.isArray(raw.outcomes)
    ? raw.outcomes
        .filter((i): i is { id?: unknown; text: string; done?: unknown; createdAt?: unknown } =>
          Boolean(
            i &&
            typeof i === 'object' &&
            typeof (i as { text?: unknown }).text === 'string' &&
            (i as { text: string }).text.trim()
          )
        )
        .map((i, idx) => ({
          id: typeof i.id === 'string' && i.id.trim() ? i.id.trim() : `outcome-${idx + 1}`,
          text: i.text.trim().slice(0, 160),
          done: Boolean(i.done),
          createdAt: typeof i.createdAt === 'string' && i.createdAt.trim() ? i.createdAt.trim() : ''
        }))
    : kpis
        .filter((k) => typeof k?.label === 'string' && k.label.trim())
        .map((k, idx) => {
          const tail = [k.current, k.target]
            .filter((p): p is string => typeof p === 'string' && Boolean(p.trim()))
            .map((p) => p.trim())
            .join(' / ')
          const label = String(k.label).trim()
          return {
            id: `outcome-${idx + 1}`,
            text: (tail ? `${label}: ${tail}` : label).slice(0, 160),
            done: false,
            createdAt: ''
          }
        })
  const outcomes = rawOutcomes.slice(0, MAX_OUTCOMES)
  const roadmap = outcomes.map((o) => o.text).slice(0, MAX_ROADMAP)
  const rawGoal =
    typeof raw.goal === 'string' ? raw.goal : typeof raw.outcome === 'string' ? raw.outcome : ''
  const titleSize =
    typeof raw.titleSize === 'number' && Number.isFinite(raw.titleSize)
      ? Math.max(12, Math.min(36, Math.round(raw.titleSize)))
      : undefined
  const bgColor =
    typeof raw.bgColor === 'string' && raw.bgColor.trim() && raw.bgColor.trim() !== 'default'
      ? raw.bgColor.trim().slice(0, 64)
      : undefined

  return {
    id: String(raw.id || newSpaceId('goal')),
    title: (typeof raw.title === 'string' ? raw.title : '').trim().slice(0, 120),
    ...(titleSize ? { titleSize } : {}),
    ...(bgColor ? { bgColor } : {}),
    ...(typeof raw.emoji === 'string' && raw.emoji.trim()
      ? { emoji: raw.emoji.trim().slice(0, 32_000) }
      : {}),
    goal: rawGoal.trim().slice(0, 240),
    level: levelOf(raw),
    outcomes,
    roadmap,
    tasks: Array.isArray(raw.tasks) ? raw.tasks : [],
    asks: Array.isArray(raw.asks) ? raw.asks : [],
    status: raw.status === 'done' || raw.status === 'parked' ? raw.status : 'active',
    sortOrder: typeof raw.sortOrder === 'number' ? Math.trunc(raw.sortOrder) : 0,
    ...(typeof raw.kanbanCard === 'string' && raw.kanbanCard.trim()
      ? { kanbanCard: raw.kanbanCard.trim().slice(0, 120) }
      : {}),
    ...(typeof raw.jobPath === 'string' && raw.jobPath.trim()
      ? { jobPath: raw.jobPath.trim().slice(0, 400) }
      : {}),
    ...(isValidLayout(raw.layout) ? { layout: clampLayout(raw.layout) } : {}),
    createdAt: typeof raw.createdAt === 'number' ? raw.createdAt : 0,
    updatedAt: typeof raw.updatedAt === 'number' ? raw.updatedAt : 0
  }
}

function isValidPoint(val: unknown): val is Point {
  if (!val || typeof val !== 'object') {
    return false
  }
  const p = val as Record<string, unknown>
  return (
    typeof p.x === 'number' &&
    Number.isFinite(p.x) &&
    typeof p.y === 'number' &&
    Number.isFinite(p.y)
  )
}

export const MAX_LAYER_NAME = 120
export const MAX_GROUP_ID = 64

function cleanLayerName(raw: unknown): string | undefined {
  return typeof raw === 'string' && raw.trim() ? raw.trim().slice(0, MAX_LAYER_NAME) : undefined
}

function normalizeLayerFields(
  obj: Record<string, unknown>
): Pick<SpaceStickyNote, 'hidden' | 'groupId' | 'name' | 'opacity'> {
  const groupId =
    typeof obj.groupId === 'string' && obj.groupId.trim()
      ? obj.groupId.trim().slice(0, MAX_GROUP_ID)
      : undefined
  const name = cleanLayerName(obj.name)
  const opacity =
    typeof obj.opacity === 'number' && Number.isFinite(obj.opacity)
      ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, obj.opacity))
      : undefined
  return {
    ...(typeof obj.hidden === 'boolean' ? { hidden: obj.hidden } : {}),
    ...(groupId ? { groupId } : {}),
    ...(name ? { name } : {}),
    ...(opacity !== undefined ? { opacity } : {})
  }
}

export function clearOrphanGroups(stickies: SpaceStickyNote[]): SpaceStickyNote[] {
  const counts = new Map<string, number>()
  for (const s of stickies) {
    if (s.groupId) {
      counts.set(s.groupId, (counts.get(s.groupId) ?? 0) + 1)
    }
  }
  if (![...counts.values()].some((n) => n < 2)) {
    return stickies
  }
  return stickies.map((s) => {
    if (!s.groupId || (counts.get(s.groupId) ?? 0) >= 2) {
      return s
    }
    const { groupId: _orphan, ...rest } = s
    return rest
  })
}

export function normalizeStickyNote(raw: unknown): SpaceStickyNote | null {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') {
    return null
  }
  const obj = raw as Record<string, unknown>
  const color: StickyColor = STICKY_COLORS.includes(obj.color as StickyColor)
    ? (obj.color as StickyColor)
    : 'amber'
  const kind: 'note' | 'text' | 'shape' | undefined =
    obj.kind === 'text' || obj.kind === 'note' || obj.kind === 'shape' ? obj.kind : undefined
  const shapeType: WhiteboardShapeType | undefined = WHITEBOARD_SHAPES.includes(
    obj.shapeType as WhiteboardShapeType
  )
    ? (obj.shapeType as WhiteboardShapeType)
    : undefined
  const fillStyle: WhiteboardFillStyle | undefined = WHITEBOARD_FILL_STYLES.includes(
    obj.fillStyle as WhiteboardFillStyle
  )
    ? (obj.fillStyle as WhiteboardFillStyle)
    : undefined
  const borderStyle: WhiteboardBorderStyle | undefined = WHITEBOARD_BORDER_STYLES.includes(
    obj.borderStyle as WhiteboardBorderStyle
  )
    ? (obj.borderStyle as WhiteboardBorderStyle)
    : undefined
  const textAlign: WhiteboardTextAlign | undefined = WHITEBOARD_TEXT_ALIGNS.includes(

export function normalizeSpaceState(raw: unknown): SpaceState {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') {

      goals: [],

      placementNames: {},
      threadGoals: {},
      log: []

  const goals = Array.isArray(obj.goals)
    ? obj.goals
        .filter((i): i is LegacyGoal => Boolean(i && typeof i === 'object'))
        .map(normalizeGoal)

    ? obj.log
        .filter((e): e is Record<string, unknown> =>
          Boolean(e && typeof e === 'object' && typeof (e as { id?: unknown }).id === 'string')
        )
        .map((e) => ({
          id: String(e.id),

          at: typeof e.at === 'number' ? e.at : 0,
          kind: NOTE_KINDS.includes(e.kind as NoteKind) ? (e.kind as NoteKind) : 'note',
          text: typeof e.text === 'string' ? e.text : '',
          signature: typeof e.signature === 'string' ? e.signature : '',
          ...(typeof e.botId === 'string' && e.botId ? { botId: e.botId } : {}),
          ...(typeof e.botName === 'string' && e.botName ? { botName: e.botName } : {})
        }))
        .slice(-MAX_LOG)
    : []
  const stickies = Array.isArray(obj.stickies)
    ? clearOrphanGroups(
        obj.stickies
          .map(normalizeStickyNote)
          .filter((s): s is SpaceStickyNote => s !== null)
          .slice(0, MAX_STICKIES)

    : []
  const arrows = Array.isArray(obj.arrows)
    ? obj.arrows
        .map(normalizeArrow)
        .filter((a): a is SpaceArrow => a !== null)
        .slice(0, MAX_ARROWS)
    : []
  const nodes = Array.isArray(obj.nodes)
    ? obj.nodes
        .map((item) => normalizeCanvasNode(item, newSpaceId))
        .filter((n): n is SpaceCanvasNode => n !== null)

    ? obj.customEmojis
        .filter((e): e is string => typeof e === 'string' && Boolean(e.trim()))
        .map((e) => e.trim().slice(0, 32_000))
        .slice(0, 48)
    : []
  const removedAskIds = Array.isArray(obj.removedAskIds)
    ? [
        ...new Set(
          obj.removedAskIds.filter((id): id is string => typeof id === 'string' && Boolean(id))
        )
      ].slice(-MAX_REMOVED_ASK_IDS)
    : []
  const rawFocus =
    obj.focusRequest && typeof obj.focusRequest === 'object'
      ? (obj.focusRequest as Record<string, unknown>)
      : null
  const focusRequest: SpaceFocusRequest | undefined =
    rawFocus && typeof rawFocus.requestedAt === 'number' && Number.isFinite(rawFocus.requestedAt)
      ? {
          requestedAt: rawFocus.requestedAt,
          ...(typeof rawFocus.spaceId === 'string' && rawFocus.spaceId.trim()
            ? { spaceId: rawFocus.spaceId.trim() }
            : {}),
          ...(typeof rawFocus.tabId === 'string' && rawFocus.tabId.trim()
            ? { tabId: rawFocus.tabId.trim() }
            : {}),
          ...(typeof rawFocus.terminalHandle === 'string' && rawFocus.terminalHandle.trim()
            ? { terminalHandle: rawFocus.terminalHandle.trim() }
            : {}),
          ...(typeof rawFocus.agentName === 'string' && rawFocus.agentName.trim()
            ? { agentName: rawFocus.agentName.trim() }
            : {}),
          ...(typeof rawFocus.role === 'string' && rawFocus.role.trim()
            ? { role: rawFocus.role.trim() }
            : {})
        }
      : undefined
  const projectSlug =
    typeof obj.projectSlug === 'string' && obj.projectSlug.trim()
      ? obj.projectSlug.trim().slice(0, 80)
      : undefined
  const agentRoles = cleanMap(obj.agentRoles)
  return {
    rev: typeof obj.rev === 'number' && Number.isFinite(obj.rev) ? Math.trunc(obj.rev) : 0,
    ...(projectSlug ? { projectSlug } : {}),
    goals,
    placements: cleanMap(obj.placements),
    placementNames: cleanMap(obj.placementNames),
    ...(Object.keys(agentRoles).length > 0 ? { agentRoles } : {}),
    threadGoals: cleanMap(obj.threadGoals),
    log,
    visualFirst: obj.visualFirst === true,
    ...(isValidLayout(obj.bench) ? { bench: clampLayout(obj.bench) } : {}),
    ...(stickies.length > 0 ? { stickies } : {}),
    ...(arrows.length > 0 ? { arrows } : {}),
    ...(nodes.length > 0 ? { nodes } : {}),
    ...(customEmojis.length > 0 ? { customEmojis } : {}),
    ...(focusRequest ? { focusRequest } : {}),
    ...(removedAskIds.length > 0 ? { removedAskIds } : {})
  }
}

export const WHITEBOARD_GOAL_FIELDS = [
  'layout',
  'title',
  'titleSize',
  'emoji',
  'bgColor',
  'level',
  'status',
  'goal'
] as const
type WhiteboardGoalField = (typeof WHITEBOARD_GOAL_FIELDS)[number]

export function isUndoableGoalPatch(patch: Partial<SpaceGoal>): boolean {
  return WHITEBOARD_GOAL_FIELDS.some((key) => Object.hasOwn(patch, key))
}

export type WhiteboardGoalSnapshot = Partial<Pick<SpaceGoal, WhiteboardGoalField>> & {
  id: string
  body: Omit<SpaceGoal, 'asks'>
}

export type WhiteboardSnapshot = {
  projectSlug?: string
  goals: WhiteboardGoalSnapshot[]
  bench?: SpaceLayout
  stickies?: SpaceStickyNote[]
  arrows?: SpaceArrow[]
  nodes?: SpaceCanvasNode[]
}

export type WhiteboardHistory = {
  past: WhiteboardSnapshot[]
  future: WhiteboardSnapshot[]
  lastText: { id: string; at: number } | null
}

export const MAX_WHITEBOARD_HISTORY = 40
export const WHITEBOARD_TEXT_MERGE_MS = 1000

export function emptyWhiteboardHistory(): WhiteboardHistory {
  return { past: [], future: [], lastText: null }
}

export function pickWhiteboardFields(goal: SpaceGoal): WhiteboardGoalSnapshot {
  const { asks: _asks, ...body } = goal
  const picked: WhiteboardGoalSnapshot = { id: goal.id, body: structuredClone(body) }
  for (const key of WHITEBOARD_GOAL_FIELDS) {
    if (goal[key] !== undefined) {
      ;(picked as Record<string, unknown>)[key] = structuredClone(goal[key])
    }
  }
  return picked
}

export function captureWhiteboardSnapshot(state: SpaceState): WhiteboardSnapshot {
  return {
    ...(state.projectSlug ? { projectSlug: state.projectSlug } : {}),
    goals: state.goals.map(pickWhiteboardFields),
    ...(state.bench ? { bench: { ...state.bench } } : {}),
    ...(state.stickies ? { stickies: structuredClone(state.stickies) } : {}),
    ...(state.arrows ? { arrows: structuredClone(state.arrows) } : {}),
    ...(state.nodes ? { nodes: structuredClone(state.nodes) } : {})
  }
}

export function restoreWhiteboardSnapshot(
  current: SpaceState,
  snap: WhiteboardSnapshot
): SpaceState {
  const live = new Map(current.goals.map((goal) => [goal.id, goal]))
  const snapIds = new Set(snap.goals.map((goal) => goal.id))
  const placedGoalIds = new Set(Object.values(current.placements ?? {}))
  const goals: SpaceGoal[] = snap.goals.map((picked) => {
    const base: SpaceGoal = live.get(picked.id) ?? { ...structuredClone(picked.body), asks: [] }
    const next: SpaceGoal = { ...base }
    for (const key of WHITEBOARD_GOAL_FIELDS) {
      if (picked[key] === undefined) {
        delete next[key]
      } else {
        ;(next as Record<string, unknown>)[key] = structuredClone(picked[key])
      }
    }
    return next
  })
  for (const goal of current.goals) {
    if (snapIds.has(goal.id)) {
      continue
    }
    if (goal.asks.length > 0 || placedGoalIds.has(goal.id)) {
      goals.push(goal)
    }
  }
  const next: SpaceState = { ...current, goals }
  for (const key of ['projectSlug', 'bench', 'stickies', 'arrows', 'nodes'] as const) {
    if (snap[key] === undefined) {
      delete next[key]
    } else {
      ;(next as Record<string, unknown>)[key] = structuredClone(snap[key])
    }
  }
  return next
}

export function recordWhiteboardHistory(
  history: WhiteboardHistory,
  state: SpaceState,
  now: number,
  coalesceTextStickyId?: string
): WhiteboardHistory {
  let lastText: WhiteboardHistory['lastText'] = null
  if (coalesceTextStickyId) {
    const prev = history.lastText
    if (prev && prev.id === coalesceTextStickyId && now - prev.at < WHITEBOARD_TEXT_MERGE_MS) {
      return { ...history, lastText: { id: prev.id, at: now } }
    }
    lastText = { id: coalesceTextStickyId, at: now }
  }
  return {
    past: [...history.past.slice(-(MAX_WHITEBOARD_HISTORY - 1)), captureWhiteboardSnapshot(state)],
    future: [],
    lastText
  }
}

export function stepWhiteboardHistory(
  history: WhiteboardHistory,
  current: SpaceState,
  direction: 'undo' | 'redo'
): { history: WhiteboardHistory; space: SpaceState } | null {
  const from = direction === 'undo' ? history.past : history.future
  const to = direction === 'undo' ? history.future : history.past
  const target = from.at(-1)
  if (!target) {
    return null
  }
  const nextTo = [...to.slice(-(MAX_WHITEBOARD_HISTORY - 1)), captureWhiteboardSnapshot(current)]
  const nextFrom = from.slice(0, -1)
  return {
    history: {
      past: direction === 'undo' ? nextFrom : nextTo,
      future: direction === 'undo' ? nextTo : nextFrom,
      lastText: null
    },
    space: restoreWhiteboardSnapshot(current, target)
  }
}

function isTypingElement(target: EventTarget | null): boolean {
  const el = target as HTMLElement | null
  if (!el || typeof el !== 'object') {
    return false
  }
  const tag = typeof el.tagName === 'string' ? el.tagName.toUpperCase() : ''
  if (tag === 'INPUT' || tag === 'TEXTAREA' || tag === 'SELECT') {
    return true
  }
  if (el.isContentEditable) {
    return true
  }
  return Boolean(
    el.closest?.('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable="true"], [contenteditable=""]')
  )
}

  if (axis === 'horizontal') {
    return (
      <svg viewBox="0 0 14 14" className="size-3.5" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
        <path
          d="M2 2.2v9.6M12 2.2v9.6"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth="1.4"
          strokeLinecap="round"
        />
        <rect x="5.6" y="3.5" width="2.8" height="7" rx="0.8" fill="currentColor" />
      </svg>
    )
  }
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 14 14" className="size-3.5" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
      <path
        d="M2.2 2h9.6M2.2 12h9.6"
        stroke="currentColor"
        strokeWidth="1.4"
        strokeLinecap="round"
      />
      <rect x="3.5" y="5.6" width="7" height="2.8" rx="0.8" fill="currentColor" />
    </svg>
  )
}

/** Floating AFFiNE tooltip pill with crisp keycap badge and bottom pointer caret. */
function AffineFloatingTooltip({
  label,
  shortcut,
  centerX
}: {
  label: string
  shortcut?: string
  centerX: number
}): React.JSX.Element {
  return (
    <div
      style={{ left: `${Math.round(centerX)}px` }}
      className="pointer-events-none absolute -top-11 z-50 -translate-x-1/2 whitespace-nowrap"
    >
      <div className="relative flex items-center gap-2 rounded-[10px] border border-white/[0.09] bg-[#323237] px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[12px] font-medium text-zinc-200 shadow-[0_10px_26px_rgba(0,0,0,0.55)]">
        <span>{label}</span>
        {shortcut ? (
          <kbd className="rounded-[5px] bg-white/[0.11] px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10.5px] font-semibold leading-none text-zinc-200">
            {shortcut}
          </kbd>
        ) : null}
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          className="absolute -bottom-1 left-1/2 size-2 -translate-x-1/2 rotate-45 border-r border-b border-white/[0.09] bg-[#323237]"
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. WhiteboardEdgelessDock
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type WhiteboardEdgelessDockProps = {
  toolMode?: ToolbarToolMode
  onChangeToolMode?: (mode: ToolbarToolMode) => void
  activeShapeType?: ToolbarShapeType
  onChangeShapeType?: (shapeType: ToolbarShapeType) => void
  activeShapeColor?: ToolbarColor
  onChangeShapeColor?: (color: ToolbarColor) => void
  activeFillStyle?: ToolbarFillStyle
  onChangeFillStyle?: (fillStyle: ToolbarFillStyle) => void
  activeArrowRouting?: ToolbarArrowRouting
  onChangeArrowRouting?: (routing: ToolbarArrowRouting) => void
  activeArrowDash?: 'solid' | 'dashed'
  onChangeArrowDash?: (dash: 'solid' | 'dashed') => void
  dockSpaceLevel?: SpaceLevel
  onChangeDockSpaceLevel?: (level: SpaceLevel) => void
  dockNoteColor?: ToolbarColor
  onChangeDockNoteColor?: (color: ToolbarColor) => void
  spawners?: readonly SpaceSpawner[]
  selectedHarness?: SpaceHarnessId
  onSelectHarness?: (harness: SpaceHarnessId) => void
  selectedModelId?: string
  onSelectModelId?: (modelId: string) => void
  modelOptions?: readonly ToolbarModelOption[]
  askBeforeSpawn?: boolean
  onToggleAskBeforeSpawn?: (next: boolean) => void
  askModelOnDrop?: boolean
  onToggleAskModelOnDrop?: (next: boolean) => void
  onStartDockItemDrag?: (
    kind: ToolbarDockItemKind,
    event: React.PointerEvent,
    options?: ToolbarDockDragOptions
  ) => void
  onStartSpawnDrag?: (spawnerId: string, event: React.PointerEvent) => void
  onStartAgentSpawnDrag?: (spawnerId: string, event: React.PointerEvent) => void
  onSpawnAgent?: (spawner: SpaceSpawner) => void
  isDraggingSpawn?: boolean
  isDraggingBot?: boolean
  isOverTrash?: boolean
  activeTextPreset?: ToolbarTextCardPresetId
  onSelectTextPreset?: (preset: ToolbarTextPresetSpec) => void
  hintText?: string | null
  className?: string
  /** Narrow canvas: the tool row scrolls sideways with a visible thin scrollbar (never clipped silently). */
  narrow?: boolean
}

export type WhiteboardToolbarProps = WhiteboardEdgelessDockProps

export const WhiteboardEdgelessDock = React.memo(function WhiteboardEdgelessDock({
  toolMode = 'select',
  onChangeToolMode,
  activeShapeType = 'rounded',
  onChangeShapeType,
  activeShapeColor = 'amber',
  onChangeShapeColor,
  activeFillStyle = 'soft',
  onChangeFillStyle,
  activeArrowRouting = 'curve',
  onChangeArrowRouting,
  activeArrowDash = 'solid',
  onChangeArrowDash,
  dockSpaceLevel = 'P1',
  onChangeDockSpaceLevel,
  dockNoteColor = 'amber',
  onChangeDockNoteColor,
  spawners = A01_TEAM_SPAWNERS,
  selectedHarness,
  onSelectHarness,
  selectedModelId,
  onSelectModelId,
  modelOptions,
  askBeforeSpawn,
  onToggleAskBeforeSpawn,
  askModelOnDrop,
  onToggleAskModelOnDrop,
  onStartDockItemDrag,
  onStartSpawnDrag,
  onStartAgentSpawnDrag,
  onSpawnAgent,
  isDraggingSpawn = false,
  isDraggingBot = false,
  isOverTrash = false,
  activeTextPreset = 'backed-label',
  onSelectTextPreset,
  hintText,
  className = '',
  narrow = false
}: WhiteboardEdgelessDockProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  const pillRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  const spawnTrayRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  const dragCleanupRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null)
  const wellDragCleanupRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null)
  const wellDraggedRef = useRef(false)

  const [openPopover, setOpenPopover] = useState<DockPopoverId | null>(null)
  const [selectedPresetId, setSelectedPresetId] =
    useState<ToolbarTextCardPresetId>(activeTextPreset)
  const [hoveredTooltip, setHoveredTooltip] = useState<HoverTooltipState | null>(null)
  const [spawnSearch, setSpawnSearch] = useState('')
  const [internalModelId, setInternalModelId] = useState<string>(DEFAULT_SPACE_MODEL_ID)
  const [internalHarness, setInternalHarness] = useState<SpaceHarnessId>('agy')
  const [internalAsk, setInternalAsk] = useState<boolean>(true)
  const [isLocalDraggingSpawn, setIsLocalDraggingSpawn] = useState(false)

  const triggerSpawnDrag = onStartSpawnDrag ?? onStartAgentSpawnDrag
  const effectiveModelId = selectedModelId ?? internalModelId
  const effectiveAsk = askBeforeSpawn ?? askModelOnDrop ?? internalAsk

  const matchedKnownModel = useMemo(
    () =>
      modelOptions?.find((m) => m.id === effectiveModelId) ??
      SPACE_HARNESS_MODELS.find((m) => m.id === effectiveModelId),
    [effectiveModelId, modelOptions]
  )

  const activeHarness: SpaceHarnessId =
    selectedHarness ?? matchedKnownModel?.harness ?? internalHarness

  const resolvedTrayModels = useMemo(() => {
    if (modelOptions && modelOptions.length > 0) {
      const byHarness = modelOptions.filter((m) => m.harness === activeHarness)
      return byHarness.length > 0 ? byHarness : modelOptions
    }
    return SPACE_HARNESS_MODELS.filter((m) => m.harness === activeHarness)
  }, [activeHarness, modelOptions])

  const unchainOptgroupModels = useMemo(() => {
    if (modelOptions && modelOptions.length > 0) {
      return []
    }
    if (activeHarness === 'unchain') {
      return []
    }
    return SPACE_HARNESS_MODELS.filter((m) => m.harness === 'unchain')
  }, [activeHarness, modelOptions])

  const selectedSelectValue = useMemo(() => {
    if (
      resolvedTrayModels.some((m) => m.id === effectiveModelId) ||
      unchainOptgroupModels.some((m) => m.id === effectiveModelId)
    ) {
      return effectiveModelId
    }
    return resolvedTrayModels[0]?.id ?? effectiveModelId
  }, [effectiveModelId, resolvedTrayModels, unchainOptgroupModels])

  const filteredSpawners = useMemo(() => {
    const q = spawnSearch.trim().toLowerCase()
    if (!q) {
      return spawners
    }
    return spawners.filter(
      (spawner) =>
        spawner.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        spawner.subtitle.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        spawner.badge.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        spawner.id.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    )
  }, [spawnSearch, spawners])

  const spawnerSections = useMemo(() => groupSpawners(filteredSpawners), [filteredSpawners])

  const currentTextPreset =
    TOOLBAR_TEXT_PRESETS.find((p) => p.id === selectedPresetId) ?? TOOLBAR_TEXT_PRESETS[0]!
  const activeShapeMeta = TOOLBAR_COLOR_SWATCH[activeShapeColor]

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      dragCleanupRef.current?.()
      dragCleanupRef.current = null
      wellDragCleanupRef.current?.()
      wellDragCleanupRef.current = null
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isDraggingSpawn) {
      setOpenPopover((cur) => (cur === 'agents-tray' ? null : cur))
      setHoveredTooltip(null)
    }
  }, [isDraggingSpawn])

  useEffect(() => {
    const onShortcutKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent): void => {
      if (isImeOwnedKeyboardEvent(event) || event.defaultPrevented || event.repeat) {
        return
      }
      if (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.altKey) {
        return
      }
      if (
        isTypingElement(event.target) ||
        (typeof document !== 'undefined' && isTypingElement(document.activeElement))
      ) {
        return
      }
      if (event.key === 'a' || event.key === 'A') {
        event.preventDefault()
        setHoveredTooltip(null)
        setOpenPopover((cur) => (cur === 'agents-tray' ? null : 'agents-tray'))
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onShortcutKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onShortcutKeyDown)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!openPopover) {
      return
    }
    const onWindowPointerDown = (event: PointerEvent): void => {
      const target = event.target as Node | null
      if (rootRef.current && target && !rootRef.current.contains(target)) {
        setOpenPopover(null)
      }
    }
    const onWindowKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent): void => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        setOpenPopover(null)
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', onWindowPointerDown)
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onWindowKeyDown)
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onWindowPointerDown)
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', onWindowKeyDown)
    }
  }, [openPopover])

  const showSlotTooltip = useCallback(
    (id: string, label: string, shortcut: string | undefined, element: HTMLElement): void => {
      const pill = pillRef.current
      if (!pill) {
        return
      }
      const pillRect = pill.getBoundingClientRect()
      const slotRect = element.getBoundingClientRect()
      const centerX = slotRect.left - pillRect.left + slotRect.width / 2
      setHoveredTooltip({ id, label, shortcut, centerX })
    },
    []
  )

  const clearSlotTooltip = useCallback((id: string): void => {
    setHoveredTooltip((cur) => (cur?.id === id ? null : cur))
  }, [])

  const togglePopover = useCallback((id: DockPopoverId): void => {
    setHoveredTooltip(null)
    setOpenPopover((cur) => (cur === id ? null : id))
  }, [])

  /**
   * Arms drag-to-canvas immediately on pointerdown while preserving `< 4px` tap-to-open-fan!
   * When the pointer moves `>= 4px`, closes any open popover so the canvas is unobstructed.
   */
  const startTactileDragOrTap = useCallback(
    (
      event: React.PointerEvent,
      onArmDrag: (ev: React.PointerEvent) => void,
      onTap: () => void
    ): void => {
      if (event.button !== 0) {
        return
      }
      event.stopPropagation()
      dragCleanupRef.current?.()
      onArmDrag(event)

      const originX = event.clientX
      const originY = event.clientY
      let moved = false

      const cleanup = (): void => {
        window.removeEventListener('pointermove', onMove)
        window.removeEventListener('pointerup', onUp)
        window.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onCancel)
        if (dragCleanupRef.current === cleanup) {
          dragCleanupRef.current = null
        }
      }

      const onMove = (moveEvent: PointerEvent): void => {
        if (!moved && Math.hypot(moveEvent.clientX - originX, moveEvent.clientY - originY) >= 4) {
          moved = true
          setOpenPopover(null)
          setHoveredTooltip(null)
        }
      }

      const onUp = (): void => {
        cleanup()
        if (!moved) {
          onTap()
        }
      }

      const onCancel = (): void => {
        cleanup()
      }

      dragCleanupRef.current = cleanup
      window.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove)
      window.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp)
      window.addEventListener('pointercancel', onCancel)
    },
    []
  )

  const handleSelectHarness = useCallback(
    (harness: SpaceHarnessId): void => {
      setInternalHarness(harness)
      onSelectHarness?.(harness)
      const pool =
        modelOptions && modelOptions.some((m) => m.harness === harness)
          ? modelOptions
          : SPACE_HARNESS_MODELS
      const firstModel = pool.find((m) => m.harness === harness)
      if (firstModel) {
        setInternalModelId(firstModel.id)
        onSelectModelId?.(firstModel.id)
      }
    },
    [modelOptions, onSelectHarness, onSelectModelId]
  )

  const handleSelectModel = useCallback(
    (modelId: string): void => {
      setInternalModelId(modelId)
      const known =
        modelOptions?.find((m) => m.id === modelId) ??
        SPACE_HARNESS_MODELS.find((m) => m.id === modelId)
      if (known?.harness) {
        setInternalHarness(known.harness)
      }
      onSelectModelId?.(modelId)
    },
    [modelOptions, onSelectModelId]
  )

  const handleToggleAsk = useCallback((): void => {
    const next = !effectiveAsk
    setInternalAsk(next)
    onToggleAskBeforeSpawn?.(next)
    onToggleAskModelOnDrop?.(next)
  }, [effectiveAsk, onToggleAskBeforeSpawn, onToggleAskModelOnDrop])

  const handleSpawnerCardPointerDown = useCallback(
    (spawner: SpaceSpawner, event: React.PointerEvent): void => {
      if (event.button !== 0) {
        return
      }
      event.stopPropagation()
      dragCleanupRef.current?.()

      const originX = event.clientX
      const originY = event.clientY
      let dragBegan = false

      const cleanup = (): void => {
        window.removeEventListener('pointermove', onMove)
        window.removeEventListener('pointerup', onUp)
        window.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onCancel)
        setIsLocalDraggingSpawn(false)
        if (dragCleanupRef.current === cleanup) {
          dragCleanupRef.current = null
        }
      }

      const onMove = (moveEvent: PointerEvent): void => {
        if (
          !dragBegan &&
          Math.hypot(moveEvent.clientX - originX, moveEvent.clientY - originY) >= 4
        ) {
          dragBegan = true
          if (spawnTrayRef.current) {
            spawnTrayRef.current.style.pointerEvents = 'none'
            spawnTrayRef.current.style.opacity = '0'
          }
          setIsLocalDraggingSpawn(true)
          setOpenPopover(null)
          setHoveredTooltip(null)
        }
      }

      const onUp = (): void => {
        const wasTap = !dragBegan
        cleanup()
        if (wasTap && onSpawnAgent) {
          onSpawnAgent(spawner)
          setOpenPopover(null)
        }
      }

      const onCancel = (): void => {
        cleanup()
      }

      dragCleanupRef.current = cleanup
      window.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove)
      window.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp)
      window.addEventListener('pointercancel', onCancel)

      triggerSpawnDrag?.(spawner.id, event)
    },
    [onSpawnAgent, triggerSpawnDrag]
  )

  const handleAgentsWellPointerDown = useCallback(
    (event: React.PointerEvent): void => {
      if (event.button !== 0) {
        return
      }
      event.stopPropagation()
      wellDraggedRef.current = false
      wellDragCleanupRef.current?.()
      if (!triggerSpawnDrag) {
        return
      }

      const originX = event.clientX
      const originY = event.clientY
      const capturedDownEvent = {
        ...event,
        button: 0,
        clientX: originX,
        clientY: originY
      } as React.PointerEvent
      const defaultSpawnerId = spawners[0]?.id ?? 'terminal'

      const cleanup = (): void => {
        window.removeEventListener('pointermove', onMove)
        window.removeEventListener('pointerup', onEnd)
        window.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onEnd)
        if (wellDragCleanupRef.current === cleanup) {
          wellDragCleanupRef.current = null
        }
      }

      const onMove = (moveEvent: PointerEvent): void => {
        if (Math.hypot(moveEvent.clientX - originX, moveEvent.clientY - originY) > 6) {
          wellDraggedRef.current = true
          cleanup()
          setOpenPopover(null)
          setHoveredTooltip(null)
          triggerSpawnDrag(defaultSpawnerId, capturedDownEvent)
          if (typeof PointerEvent !== 'undefined') {
            window.dispatchEvent(
              new PointerEvent('pointermove', {
                clientX: moveEvent.clientX,
                clientY: moveEvent.clientY,
                pointerId: moveEvent.pointerId,
                buttons: moveEvent.buttons
              })
            )
          }
        }
      }

      const onEnd = (): void => {
        cleanup()
      }

      wellDragCleanupRef.current = cleanup
      window.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove)
      window.addEventListener('pointerup', onEnd)
      window.addEventListener('pointercancel', onEnd)
    },
    [spawners, triggerSpawnDrag]
  )

  const isSelectFamily = toolMode === 'select' || toolMode === 'marquee'

  const modeBanner =
    openPopover !== null
      ? null
      : hintText
        ? hintText
        : toolMode === 'eraser'
          ? 'Eraser active — click or swipe across items to delete · Esc to exit'
          : toolMode === 'shape'
            ? `Drag on canvas to draw ${TOOLBAR_SHAPES.find((s) => s.id === activeShapeType)?.label ?? 'shape'} · Esc to exit`
            : toolMode === 'frame'
              ? `Drag on canvas to frame a ${LEVEL_STYLE[dockSpaceLevel].shortLabel} Space · Esc to exit`
              : toolMode === 'marquee'
                ? 'Drag a box on canvas to multi-select items · V for pointer'
                : null

  return (
    <div
      ref={rootRef}
      data-space-dock="true"
      onPointerDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
      onMouseDown={(event) => {
        if (isTypingElement(event.target)) {
          event.stopPropagation()
          return
        }
        event.preventDefault()
      }}
      className={`pointer-events-none flex max-w-full flex-col items-center gap-2 ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Active Agent Drag Trash Drop Zone */}
      {isDraggingBot ? (
        <div
          data-space-remove="true"
          className={`pointer-events-auto flex items-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl transition-all ${
            isOverTrash
              ? 'scale-105 border-rose-400 bg-rose-950/95 text-rose-100 ring-2 ring-rose-500/50'
              : 'border-rose-500/60 bg-[#18181b]/95 text-rose-300'
          }`}
        >
          <Trash2 className="size-3.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>
            {isOverTrash ? 'Release to remove & close agent' : 'Drop agent here to remove & close'}
          </span>
        </div>
      ) : modeBanner ? (
        <div className="pointer-events-auto max-w-full truncate rounded-full border border-white/12 bg-[#1c1c1f]/95 px-3.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-200 shadow-lg backdrop-blur-xl">
          {modeBanner}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {/* Left-Cluster Mini Sub-Menu: Pointer vs Box Marquee */}
      {openPopover === 'select-menu' ? (
        <div className="pointer-events-auto flex items-center gap-1 rounded-2xl border border-white/12 bg-[#1c1c1f]/96 p-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-200 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              onChangeToolMode?.('select')
              setOpenPopover(null)
            }}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 font-medium transition ${
              toolMode === 'select'
                ? 'bg-sky-500/18 text-sky-300 ring-1 ring-sky-400/40'
                : 'text-zinc-300 hover:bg-white/[0.08] hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <CursorPointerVector active={toolMode === 'select'} />
            <span>Pointer Select</span>
            <kbd className="rounded bg-white/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px]">V</kbd>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              onChangeToolMode?.('marquee')
              setOpenPopover(null)
            }}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 font-medium transition ${
              toolMode === 'marquee'
                ? 'bg-sky-500/18 text-sky-300 ring-1 ring-sky-400/40'
                : 'text-zinc-300 hover:bg-white/[0.08] hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <MarqueeSelectVector active={toolMode === 'marquee'} />
            <span>Box Marquee</span>
            <kbd className="rounded bg-white/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px]">M</kbd>
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {/* Left-Cluster Mini Sub-Menu: Default Space Frame Priority */}
      {openPopover === 'frame-menu' ? (
        <div className="pointer-events-auto flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 rounded-2xl border border-white/12 bg-[#1c1c1f]/96 p-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-200 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl">
          <span className="px-2 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-400">Frame priority</span>
          {SPACE_LEVELS.map((lvl) => {
            const st = LEVEL_STYLE[lvl]
            const active = dockSpaceLevel === lvl
            return (
              <button
                key={lvl}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  onChangeDockSpaceLevel?.(lvl)
                  onChangeToolMode?.('frame')
                  setOpenPopover(null)
                }}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold transition ${
                  active
                    ? 'bg-white/14 text-white ring-1 ring-sky-400/50'
                    : 'text-zinc-300 hover:bg-white/[0.08] hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                <span className={`size-2 rounded-full ${st.dot}`} />
                <span>{st.shortLabel}</span>
              </button>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {/* Left-Cluster Mini Sub-Menu: Connector Routing & Dash */}
      {openPopover === 'arrow-menu' ? (
        <div className="pointer-events-auto flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 rounded-2xl border border-white/12 bg-[#1c1c1f]/96 p-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-200 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl">
          {(
            [
              { id: 'curve', label: 'Curved' },
              { id: 'elbow', label: 'Elbow 90°' },
              { id: 'straight', label: 'Straight' }
            ] satisfies readonly { id: ToolbarArrowRouting; label: string }[]
          ).map((opt) => {
            const active = activeArrowRouting === opt.id
            return (
              <button
                key={opt.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  onChangeArrowRouting?.(opt.id)
                  onChangeToolMode?.('arrow')
                  setOpenPopover(null)
                }}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold transition ${
                  active
                    ? 'bg-sky-500/18 text-sky-300 ring-1 ring-sky-400/45'
                    : 'text-zinc-300 hover:bg-white/[0.08] hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                <ConnectorCurveVector active={active} routing={opt.id} />
                <span>{opt.label}</span>
              </button>
            )
          })}
          <span className="h-5 w-px bg-white/10" />
          {(
            [
              { id: 'solid', label: 'Solid' },
              { id: 'dashed', label: 'Dashed' }
            ] as const
          ).map((strokeOpt) => {
            const active = activeArrowDash === strokeOpt.id
            return (
              <button
                key={strokeOpt.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  onChangeArrowDash?.(strokeOpt.id)
                  onChangeToolMode?.('arrow')

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 2. WhiteboardItemInspector (AFFiNE Floating Selection Toolbar)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type WhiteboardItemInspectorProps = {
  kind: WhiteboardInspectorKind
  shapeType?: ToolbarShapeType
  fillStyle?: ToolbarFillStyle
  borderStyle?: ToolbarBorderStyle
  color?: ToolbarColor
  fontSize?: number
  fontFamily?: ToolbarFontFamily
  bold?: boolean
  textAlign?: ToolbarTextAlign
  locked?: boolean
  isEditing?: boolean
  onChangeShapeType?: (shapeType: ToolbarShapeType) => void
  onConvertToShape?: (shapeType?: ToolbarShapeType) => void
  onChangeFillStyle?: (fillStyle: ToolbarFillStyle) => void
  onChangeBorderStyle?: (borderStyle: ToolbarBorderStyle) => void
  onChangeColor?: (color: ToolbarColor) => void
  onChangeFontSize?: (fontSize: number) => void
  onChangeFontFamily?: (fontFamily: ToolbarFontFamily) => void
  onToggleBold?: (bold: boolean) => void
  onChangeTextAlign?: (align: ToolbarTextAlign) => void
  onBringToFront?: () => void
  onSendToBack?: () => void
  onToggleLock?: (locked: boolean) => void
  onEditText?: () => void
  onDuplicate?: () => void
  onStartConnectDrag?: (event: React.PointerEvent) => void
  onConnect?: () => void
  onDelete?: () => void
  style?: React.CSSProperties
  className?: string
}

export const WhiteboardItemInspector = React.memo(function WhiteboardItemInspector({
  kind,
  shapeType = 'rounded',
  fillStyle,
  borderStyle = 'solid',
  color = 'amber',
  fontSize,
  fontFamily = 'sans',
  bold = false,
  textAlign = 'left',
  locked = false,
  isEditing = false,
  onChangeShapeType,
  onConvertToShape,
  onChangeFillStyle,
  onChangeBorderStyle,
  onChangeColor,
  onChangeFontSize,
  onChangeFontFamily,
  onToggleBold,
  onChangeTextAlign,
  onBringToFront,
  onSendToBack,
  onToggleLock,
  onEditText,
  onDuplicate,
  onStartConnectDrag,
  onConnect,
  onDelete,
  style,
  className = ''
}: WhiteboardItemInspectorProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const resolvedFill: ToolbarFillStyle = fillStyle ?? (kind === 'text' ? 'none' : 'soft')
  const resolvedFontSize = fontSize ?? (kind === 'text' ? 26 : 16)

  // Locked Guardrail: shows ONLY `Locked 🔒 · Unlock` until unlocked
  if (locked) {
    return (
      <div
        data-whiteboard-inspector="locked"
        style={style}
        onPointerDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
        onDoubleClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
        className={`pointer-events-auto flex items-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-amber-400/35 bg-zinc-950/96 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-100 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl whitespace-nowrap ${className}`}
      >
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-300">
          <Lock className="size-3.5" />
          <span>Locked</span>
        </span>
        <span className="h-3.5 w-px bg-white/15" />
        <button
          type="button"
          title="Unlock item to move or edit"
          onClick={() => onToggleLock?.(false)}
          className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-amber-400/18 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-200 transition hover:bg-amber-400/30 hover:text-white"
        >
          <Unlock className="size-3.5" />
          <span>Unlock</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div
      data-whiteboard-inspector={kind}
      style={style}
      onPointerDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
      onMouseDown={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
      onDoubleClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
      className={`pointer-events-auto flex max-w-full flex-col gap-1.5 rounded-2xl border border-white/15 bg-zinc-950/96 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-100 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Row 1: Shape / Box-Bg / Fill + Border + 8 Color Swatches */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto whitespace-nowrap [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden">
        {kind === 'text' ? (
          <>
            <span className="px-1 text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-wide text-zinc-400 uppercase">
              Box Bg
            </span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-zinc-900 p-0.5">
              {(
                [
                  { id: 'none', label: 'None' },
                  { id: 'soft', label: 'Soft' },
                  { id: 'solid', label: 'Solid' },
                  { id: 'paper', label: 'Paper' },
                  { id: 'paper-light', label: 'Light' },
                  { id: 'glass', label: 'Glass' }
                ] satisfies readonly { id: ToolbarFillStyle; label: string }[]
              ).map((opt) => {
                const active = resolvedFill === opt.id
                return (
                  <button
                    key={opt.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onChangeFillStyle?.(opt.id)}
                    className={`rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] font-semibold transition ${
                      active
                        ? 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-950'
                        : 'text-zinc-400 hover:bg-white/[0.06] hover:text-zinc-200'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {opt.label}
                  </button>
                )
              })}
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              title="Convert text into a resizable fixed-box Shape"
              onClick={() => {
                if (onConvertToShape) {
                  onConvertToShape('rounded')
                  return
                }
                onChangeShapeType?.('rounded')

export type WhiteboardMultiSelectBarProps = {
  selectedCount: number
  activeColor?: ToolbarColor
  activeFillStyle?: ToolbarFillStyle
  allLocked?: boolean
  onAlign?: (alignment: ToolbarMultiAlign) => void
  onDistribute?: (axis: ToolbarMultiDistribute) => void
  onBatchColor?: (color: ToolbarColor) => void
  onBatchFillStyle?: (fillStyle: ToolbarFillStyle) => void
  onBringToFront?: () => void
  onSendToBack?: () => void
  onDuplicate?: () => void
  onToggleLock?: (locked: boolean) => void
  onDelete?: () => void
  onClearSelection?: () => void
  style?: React.CSSProperties
  className?: string
}

const MULTI_ALIGN_OPTIONS: readonly { id: ToolbarMultiAlign; label: string }[] = [
  { id: 'left', label: 'Align Left' },
  { id: 'center', label: 'Align Center Horizontally' },
  { id: 'right', label: 'Align Right' },
  { id: 'top', label: 'Align Top' },
  { id: 'middle', label: 'Align Middle Vertically' },
  { id: 'bottom', label: 'Align Bottom' }
]

export const WhiteboardMultiSelectBar = React.memo(function WhiteboardMultiSelectBar({
  selectedCount,
  activeColor,
  activeFillStyle,
  allLocked = false,
  onAlign,
  onDistribute,
  onBatchColor,
  onBatchFillStyle,
  onBringToFront,
  onSendToBack,
  onDuplicate,
  onToggleLock,
  onDelete,
  onClearSelection,
  style,
  className = ''
}: WhiteboardMultiSelectBarProps): React.JSX.Element | null {
  if (selectedCount < 2) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    <div
      data-whiteboard-multiselect="true"
      style={style}
      onPointerDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
      onMouseDown={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
      onDoubleClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
      className={`pointer-events-auto flex max-w-full items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto rounded-2xl border border-white/15 bg-[#0c0d10] px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-100 shadow-2xl whitespace-nowrap [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Count Badge */}
      <span className="rounded-lg bg-sky-500/18 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] font-semibold text-sky-300 ring-1 ring-sky-400/35">
        {selectedCount} selected
      </span>

      <span className="h-3.5 w-px shrink-0 bg-white/12" />

      {/* Align Left / Center / Right / Top / Middle / Bottom */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-zinc-900 p-0.5">
        {MULTI_ALIGN_OPTIONS.map((al) => (
          <button
            key={al.id}
            type="button"
            title={al.label}
            aria-label={al.label}
            onClick={() => onAlign?.(al.id)}
            className="flex size-5.5 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-zinc-300 transition hover:bg-white/12 hover:text-white"
          >
            <MultiAlignGlyph kind={al.id} />
          </button>
        ))}

        {/* Distribute H / V when selectedCount >= 3 */}
        {selectedCount >= 3 ? (
          <>
            <span className="mx-0.5 h-3.5 w-px bg-white/12" />
            <button
              type="button"
              title="Distribute Horizontally"
              aria-label="Distribute Horizontally"
              onClick={() => onDistribute?.('horizontal')}
              className="flex size-5.5 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-zinc-300 transition hover:bg-white/12 hover:text-white"
            >
              <MultiDistributeGlyph axis="horizontal" />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              title="Distribute Vertically"
              aria-label="Distribute Vertically"
              onClick={() => onDistribute?.('vertical')}
              className="flex size-5.5 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-zinc-300 transition hover:bg-white/12 hover:text-white"
            >
              <MultiDistributeGlyph axis="vertical" />
            </button>
          </>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <span className="h-3.5 w-px shrink-0 bg-white/12" />

      {/* Batch 8 Color Dots */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
        {TOOLBAR_COLORS.map((c) => {
          const sw = TOOLBAR_COLOR_SWATCH[c]
          const active = activeColor === c
          return (
            <button
              key={c}
              type="button"
              title={`Set color: ${sw.label}`}
              aria-label={`Batch color ${sw.label}`}
              onClick={() => onBatchColor?.(c)}
              className={`size-3 shrink-0 rounded-full transition-transform hover:scale-120 ${sw.dotClass} ${
                active
                  ? 'ring-2 ring-white ring-offset-1 ring-offset-zinc-950'
                  : 'opacity-80 hover:opacity-100'
              }`}
            />
          )
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Batch Fill: Soft / Solid / Paper / Glass */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-zinc-900 p-0.5">
        {(
          [
            { id: 'soft', label: 'Soft' },
            { id: 'solid', label: 'Solid' },
            { id: 'paper', label: 'Paper' },
            { id: 'paper-light', label: 'Light' },
            { id: 'glass', label: 'Glass' }
          ] satisfies readonly { id: ToolbarFillStyle; label: string }[]
        ).map((f) => {
          const active = activeFillStyle === f.id
          return (
            <button
              key={f.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onBatchFillStyle?.(f.id)}
              className={`rounded-lg px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold transition ${
                active
                  ? 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-950'
                  : 'text-zinc-400 hover:bg-white/[0.08] hover:text-zinc-200'
              }`}
            >
              {f.label}
            </button>
          )
        })}
      </div>

      <span className="h-3.5 w-px shrink-0 bg-white/12" />

      {/* Bring Front / Send Back / Duplicate / Lock / Delete */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
        <button
          type="button"
          title="Bring to Front"
          aria-label="Bring selection to Front"
          onClick={() => onBringToFront?.()}
          className="flex size-5.5 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-zinc-300 transition hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white"
        >
          <BringToFront className="size-3.5" />
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          title="Send to Back"
          aria-label="Send selection to Back"
          onClick={() => onSendToBack?.()}
          className="flex size-5.5 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-zinc-300 transition hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white"
        >
          <SendToBack className="size-3.5" />
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          title="Duplicate selected items (⌘D)"
          aria-label="Duplicate selected items"
          onClick={() => onDuplicate?.()}
          className="flex size-5.5 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-zinc-300 transition hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white"
        >
          <Copy className="size-3.5" />
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          title={allLocked ? 'Unlock selected items' : 'Lock selected items'}
          aria-label={allLocked ? 'Unlock selected items' : 'Lock selected items'}
          aria-pressed={allLocked}
          onClick={() => onToggleLock?.(!allLocked)}
          className={`flex size-5.5 items-center justify-center rounded-lg transition ${
            allLocked
              ? 'bg-amber-400/20 text-amber-300 ring-1 ring-amber-400/40'
              : 'text-zinc-300 hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-amber-300'
          }`}
        >
          {allLocked ? <Unlock className="size-3.5" /> : <Lock className="size-3.5" />}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          title="Delete selected items (⌫)"
          aria-label="Delete selected items"
          onClick={() => onDelete?.()}
          className="flex size-5.5 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-rose-300 transition hover:bg-rose-500/25 hover:text-rose-100"
        >
          <Trash2 className="size-3.5" />
        </button>
        {onClearSelection ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            title="Clear selection (Esc)"
            aria-label="Clear selection"
            onClick={onClearSelection}
            className="flex size-5.5 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-zinc-400 transition hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white"
          >
            <X className="size-3.5" />
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
})

        onClick={() => {
          if (canRedo) {

        className={`flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-xl transition ${

            : 'cursor-not-allowed text-muted-foreground/35'
        }`}
      >
        <Redo2 className="size-3.5" />
      </button>
    </div>
  )
